szoveg_eredeti:
Perplexity is turning into a work operating system. Slide decks you create in Perplexity Computer now have a native viewer that allows you to edit in place. Supports both PowerPoint and Google Slides.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Daniel Wang (@danielywang4); megjelent: 2026-11-24T22:39:34+00:00; link: https://x.com/danielywang4/status/2125358695701995792; média: videó, 49 másodperc]
Native PowerPoint viewer is live on Perplexity web

View complex decks cleanly in the browser, edit in Google Slides or PowerPoint, and see updates reflected back in Perplexity
